description: Verify Event/Scene/Issue-Task association on the FDE教练迁移验收 robot path: outbound dws to 冬翔, bind, and recall. Prompts and assertions live in the suite, not here.

scenarioGroups.title: Sandbox dws outbound is real delivery
scenarioGroups.why: Assistant text in the robot chat is not delivery. Only an independent DingTalk readback of a message to 冬翔 proves egress.

scenarioGroups.title: Outbound scene binds to the Issue and later replies recall it
scenarioGroups.why: A new DM cid must hang on the same Issue. Recall by conversation_id is the product contract, not chat history reconstruction.

scenarioGroups.title: Coordinator clarifies then assigns, does not fake DWS
scenarioGroups.why: The short loop may ack and open an Issue. It must not claim the DM was sent.

scenarioGroups.title: Robot inbound is a distinct scene from the 冬翔 DM
scenarioGroups.why: Robot cid and digital-employee cid are different. Binding the wrong scene makes recall lie.
